methodology_note: Bahcall & Wolf (1976) relaxed stellar-cusp power law (gamma=1.75), normalized by cross-calibration against this site's own Sgr A* nuclear star cluster field, not a per-galaxy literature photometric fit — individual nuclear stars in M87 or NGC 4258 are far beyond resolution from Earth at their real distance. Illustrative density only; do not cite as a per-galaxy stellar count.
